## 5. Regulation & Policy

- **Date:** 2026-05-19  
  **Link:** [FTC — Complying with the Take It Down Act](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/complying-take-it-down-act)  
  **Summary:** FTC guidance says Section 3 of the Take It Down Act is effective May 19, 2026. Covered platforms must provide notice-and-removal mechanisms for nonconsensual intimate images, including AI-created or altered “digital forgeries,” and remove valid reports within 48 hours.  
  **Why it matters:** Creates a concrete compliance deadline and enforcement exposure for platforms hosting user-generated AI media.
